hints.title: Inversion Criterion
hints.text: If any character b precedes an a, the substring ba must appear at least once.

hints.title: Substring Containment
hints.text: Verify whether the two-character sequence ba is absent from the input string.

hints.title: Direct Boolean Return
hints.text: Return true when ba is not contained in the string, otherwise false.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(N) single pass pattern containment check
complexity.notes: String is invalid if and only if "ba" occurs as a contiguous substring.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Tracking multiple state indices is redundant when substring search suffices.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Checking for substring "ba" executes in linear time with zero allocations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that all As precede all Bs iff ba never appears.
